description: Run by the Brand Kit setup process. In check mode it validates a Brand Kit (company name, hex colours, links) and prepares the reviewer's summary; in confirm mode it marks the Brand Kit confirmed, raises its version and saves a copy in Knowledge for the agent. Uses no AI and sends nothing.

import json
import re

# Node params arrive in the `params` dict (sandbox-bootstrap.py), not as variables.
record_id = params["record_id"]
mode = params["mode"]

SLUG = "social_brand_kits"
HEX = re.compile(r"^#(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{3}|[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})$")
COLOUR_FIELDS = [
    ("primary_colour", "Primary colour"),
    ("primary_text_colour", "Primary text colour"),
    ("secondary_text_colour", "Secondary text colour"),
    ("heading_colour", "Heading colour"),
    ("subheading_colour", "Sub-heading colour"),
]
RECOMMENDED = [
    ("target_audience", "Target audience"),
    ("language_style", "Language style"),
    ("key_messages", "Key messages"),
    ("default_cta", "Default call to action"),
    ("primary_colour", "Primary colour"),
    ("logo_file", "Logo file"),
]
LISTS = ["services", "key_messages", "words_to_avoid", "claims_not_allowed", "mandatory_disclaimers"]


def text(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return ", ".join(str(v) for v in value)
    return str(value).strip()


def lines(value):
    return [part.strip() for part in text(value).splitlines() if part.strip()]


found = api.records.get(type_slug=SLUG, record_id=record_id)
row = (found or {}).get("record") or {}
missing = not row
if missing and mode != "check":
    raise RuntimeError("The Brand Kit record was not found. It may have been deleted or archived.")
data = row.get("data") or {}
company = text(row.get("title") or data.get("company_name"))

issues = []
warnings = []
if missing:
    issues.append("The Brand Kit record was not found. It may have been deleted or archived.")
elif not company:
    issues.append("Company name is empty.")
for key, label in COLOUR_FIELDS:
    value = text(data.get(key))
    if value and not HEX.match(value):
        issues.append(f"{label} '{value}' is not a hex colour like #1F2A5C.")
secondary = [part.strip() for part in text(data.get("secondary_colours")).split(",") if part.strip()]
for value in secondary:
    if not HEX.match(value):
        issues.append(f"Secondary colour '{value}' is not a hex colour like #1F2A5C.")
for key in ("website", "default_cta_url"):
    value = text(data.get(key))
    if value and not value.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        issues.append(f"{key.replace('_', ' ').capitalize()} '{value}' should start with https://.")
for key, label in RECOMMENDED:
    if not text(data.get(key)):
        warnings.append(f"{label} is empty, so drafts will show [[MISSING]] or fall back to defaults.")
if not text(data.get("sender_address")):
    warnings.append("Sender name and address is empty, so email drafts cannot include a compliant footer.")

valid = len(issues) == 0
current_version = int(data.get("version") or 0)

summary_lines = [f"Brand Kit: {company or '(no company name)'}"]
summary_lines.append(f"Website: {text(data.get('website')) or '(none)'}")
summary_lines.append(f"Audience: {text(data.get('target_audience')) or '(none)'}")
summary_lines.append(f"Voice: {text(data.get('language_style')) or '(none)'}")
summary_lines.append(f"Key messages: {len(lines(data.get('key_messages')))}; words to avoid: {len(lines(data.get('words_to_avoid')))}; claims not allowed: {len(lines(data.get('claims_not_allowed')))}; disclaimers: {len(lines(data.get('mandatory_disclaimers')))}")
summary_lines.append(f"Colours: {text(data.get('primary_colour')) or '(none)'}{(' + ' + ', '.join(secondary)) if secondary else ''}")
summary_lines.append(f"Default call to action: {text(data.get('default_cta')) or '(none)'}")
if issues:
    summary_lines.append("Problems: " + " ".join(issues))
if warnings:
    summary_lines.append("Notes: " + " ".join(warnings))
summary = "\n".join(summary_lines)

brief = {
    "question": f"Confirm the Brand Kit for {company or 'this business'}? The Social Media Agent drafts every piece from the confirmed version.",
    "facts": summary_lines,
    "recommendation": "Confirm if this describes the business and how it should sound. Choose Needs changes to edit the Brand Kit first.",
    "recommendedOption": "confirm",
    "consequence": "Confirming marks the Brand Kit confirmed, raises its version and saves a copy in Knowledge for the agent. Nothing is published or sent.",
    "uncertainty": " ".join(warnings) if warnings else "No missing recommended fields.",
    "evidence": [],
}

version = current_version
knowledge_path = ""
if mode == "confirm":
    if not valid:
        raise RuntimeError("The Brand Kit has problems, so it cannot be confirmed: " + " ".join(issues))
    version = current_version + 1
    api.records.update(type_slug=SLUG, record_id=record_id, record={"data": {"status": "confirmed", "version": version}})
    settings = api.extension.settings() or {}
    folder = text(settings.get("knowledge_folder")) or "Social posts"
    copy = {
        "company_name": company,
        "version": version,
        "record_id": record_id,
        "website": text(data.get("website")),
        "business_description": text(data.get("business_description")),
        "services": lines(data.get("services")),
        "service_area": text(data.get("service_area")),
        "phone": text(data.get("phone")),
        "contact_email": text(data.get("contact_email")),
        "sender_address": text(data.get("sender_address")),
        "target_audience": text(data.get("target_audience")),
        "language_style": text(data.get("language_style")),
        "key_messages": lines(data.get("key_messages")),
        "default_cta": text(data.get("default_cta")),
        "default_cta_url": text(data.get("default_cta_url")),
        "words_to_avoid": lines(data.get("words_to_avoid")),
        "claims_not_allowed": lines(data.get("claims_not_allowed")),
        "mandatory_disclaimers": lines(data.get("mandatory_disclaimers")),
        "colours": {
            "primary": text(data.get("primary_colour")),
            "secondary": secondary,
            "primary_text": text(data.get("primary_text_colour")),
            "secondary_text": text(data.get("secondary_text_colour")),
            "heading": text(data.get("heading_colour")),
            "subheading": text(data.get("subheading_colour")),
        },
        "fonts": {"heading": text(data.get("heading_font")), "body": text(data.get("body_font"))},
        "logo_file": text(data.get("logo_file")),
        "images_folder": text(data.get("images_folder")),
    }
    body = json.dumps(copy, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    knowledge_path = f"{folder}/Brand Kit/brand-kit.json"
    api.files.put(file=knowledge_path, content=body)
    api.files.put(file=f"{folder}/Brand Kit/brand-kit-v{version}.json", content=body)
